q: Which instrument is part of the minimum equipment required for optometric practice under RA 8050?
w: The minimum set includes visual acuity charts, a trial lens set or phoropter, an ophthalmoscope and retinoscope, an ophthalmic chair, dispensing tools, and a slit lamp. Advanced imaging devices are not required.
k: Minimum equipment includes a trial lens set or phoropter.

q: Under RA 8981, leaking licensure questions or manipulating exam results is punishable by imprisonment of:
w: RA 8981 sets imprisonment of 6 years and 1 day to 12 years, a fine of P50,000 to P100,000, or both. A PRC officer or Board member is also removed and perpetually disqualified from public office.
k: Exam manipulation under RA 8981: 6 yrs 1 day to 12 yrs.
